incidents.body: This incident has been resolved. GitHub has restored the affected services on their end, and builds and Push to Deploy deployments on Galaxy are operating normally. If a deploy failed during the outage, or if a commit didn't trigger a Push to Deploy build, you can trigger it again and it should now complete as expected. We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

incidents.body: The issue affecting app visibility in the Galaxy Dashboard has been resolved. We've released a fix, and apps are now displaying correctly for all affected customers. Thanks for your patience while we worked through this. If you're still seeing any issues, please reach out to our support team.
incidents.title: Some apps not displaying in Galaxy Dashboard 2.0

incidents.body: This incident has been resolved. Monti APM has identified and addressed the issue on their end, and the service has been restored. Please note that any data inserts that failed during the outage were not recovered, but no additional data loss occurred beyond that window. We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.
incidents.title: Monti APM Connectivity Issue

incidents.body: This incident has been resolved. The deployment failures affecting CLI and Push to Deploy were most likely caused by an undocumented temporary unavailability in one of our external dependencies. The issue was not caused by any change on Galaxy's infrastructure and resolved on its own as the external service recovered. Deployments via both CLI and Push to Deploy are now operating normally. We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.
incidents.title: App Deployments Affected on CLI and Push to Deploy

incidents.body: The "Empty bundle received" error affecting CLI deployments to Galaxy Metal has been resolved. Deployments should now complete successfully.
